Job Summary

This position is under the directorate of Safety, Health, and Environment and responsible for managing environmental compliance, sustainability initiatives, and environmental protection efforts within an organization. The Environment Officer plays a key role in promoting sustainable practices, managing environmental risks, and supporting the company’s overall environmental goals.The position also involves educating staff, monitoring environmental performance, and reporting on the company’s sustainability and environmental efforts.

Job Responsibilities

Ensure the organization complies with all environmental regulations, laws, and standards at local, national, and international levels

Successfully executed Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Oversight

Drive the development of environmental management plans and sustainability strategies aligned with the company’s broader business goals.

Managing Sustainability & Environmental Performance

Identify, assess, and manage environmental risks (e.g., pollution, resource depletion, waste management), ensuring the implementation of risk control measures.

Managing environmental risks for the long term of the company

Track and report on environmental targets, providing updates on progress toward sustainability goals and recommending actions for continuous improvement.

Monitoring, reporting, and documentation about Environment

Take an active role as role model to provide guide in upholding ethics and integrity (e.g., willing to provide guidance/consultation on ethics and integrity whenever required, continuously uphold ethical values in doing day-to-day process, etc.) in supporting company’s ethical culture.

Zero tolerance to fraud (including bribery)

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome

• SHE risks well maintained
• Target Zero LTI
• SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP, standards and requirements.

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Environmental Engineering or related field

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min 3-5 years’ experience in environmental management, sustainability, or compliance, preferably within an industrial, manufacturing, or corporate environment.
• Strong understanding of sustainability principles, environmental risk management, and best practices in waste management, energy conservation, and resource efficiency.
• Results-driven with a commitment to continuous improvement and environmental sustainability.
• Familiarity with mining and HSE.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skill
• Excellent communication, presentation, and report writing skill
• Fluent in English (written and verbal)
• Attention to detail

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

IT On-Site Support Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purpose

The IT On-Site Support Analyst provides day-to-day on-site EUC and IT infrastructure support to end-users at CASS-served sites in Indonesia, under the guidance of the Senior Analyst.

Key responsibilities include:

Day-to-Day Support:
• Resolve walk-up and assigned tickets for EUC, peripherals, printers, and basic connectivity issues.
• Execute MAC and OS / standard application updates on EUC devices.
• Provide first-line support for Microsoft 365 services (account, mailbox, Teams, OneDrive).
• Support EUC management actions in Microsoft Intune (enrolment, compliance follow-up, basic policy assignment).

Hand-and-Feet & Coordination:
• Provide hand-and-feet support for server, network, and security activities at site (cabling, equipment swap, escort).
• Coordinate with Kyndryl and other 3P field engineers on scheduled site visits.
• Maintain accurate ticket notes and contribute to site runbooks.

Job Requirements

• Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
• Minimum 2 years of EUC / desktop / on-site support experience.
• Working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (user-side), basic networking, and printer/peripheral troubleshooting.
• Exposure to Microsoft Intune is preferred.
• Familiar with ITIL incident and request management.
• Willingness to be on-site at office and plant locations and to perform hand-and-feet activities.
• Strong communication in Bahasa Indonesia; working-level English sufficient for documentation, ticket handling, and coordination with regional/3P teams.

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

Important Notes

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.chandra-asri.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
